sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Hammer Master io lies a simple yet addictive gameplay mechanic. Players control a stickman fighter with a hammer, which they use to smash, absorb, and defeat other players on the battlefield. The goal is to become bigger and stronger by absorbing the power of defeated players. This power-up system allows players to upgrade their stickman fighter, making them a formidable force on the battlefield.

As players progress through the game, they'll encounter various obstacles, such as obstacles, power-ups, and rival players. The game features a unique respawn system, where players can revive themselves after being defeated. This system encourages players to keep trying and improve their skills.

The gameplay is divided into rounds, where players compete against each other in a free-for-all format. The last stickman fighter standing wins the round and becomes the champion. Players can earn rewards, power-ups, and experience points by winning rounds and defeating rival players.

Hammer Master io also features a ranking system, where players are ranked based on their performance. The game offers various leaderboards, where players can compare their skills with others and strive to become the best.
